title: Recipient suggestions float over the composer and nothing under them moves
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData and press c; in To type the first letters of a contact
Press Down twice, then Escape; type one more letter and press Return
Open a conversation, press r and do the same in the reply's To and Cc fields
expected: The list floats under the chips and covers the From and Subject rows; nothing in the card moves or resizes. The highlighted row is a quiet grey, like the calendar's guest list, not a strong blue. The arrows move the highlight, Escape closes only the list, Return adds the highlighted person. The reply shows the same floating list.
